title.description: Short title or summary of the issue

category.description: Category of the civic issue (e.g., Pothole, Streetlight, Litter)

severity.description: Severity level of the issue, from 1 (low) to 5 (critical)

status.description: Current status of the issue resolution process

imageUrl.description: Firebase Storage URL of the issue photo

videoUrl.description: Firebase Storage URL of the optional issue video

reporterId.description: UID of the user who reported the issue

reporterName.description: Display name of the user who reported the issue

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the issue was reported

upvoteCount.description: Number of upvotes this issue has received

aiCategory.description: The category detected by Gemini AI analysis

aiSeverity.description: The severity level detected by Gemini AI analysis

aiDescription.description: The description generated by Gemini AI analysis

points.description: Gamified reputation points for reporting/upvoting issues

badges.description: List of strings representing badges earned by the user

Verification.title: Verification
Verification.description: A verification from a citizen confirming the presence of an issue.

userId.description: UID of the user who verified the issue

verifiedAt.description: Timestamp when the verification was recorded

userName.description: Display name of the user who verified the issue

/issues/{issueId}/verifications/{userId}.description: Subcollection of confirmations verifying the issue.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles stored under their Firebase Auth UID.
